import sys

def main():
    input_str = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    count = 0
    i = 0
    n = len(input_str)
    
    while i < n:
        current_char = input_str[i]
        j = i
        temp = 0
        
        while j < n and input_str[j] == current_char:
            j += 1
            temp += 1
        
        if temp % 2 == 0:
            count += 1
        
        i = j
    
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
